@@U04102@@
We were amused at first, Sire, at the wild confusion we discovered when suddenly a new Emperor appeared. Now, in order, behind false flags and following directions, the mob marches across the plain— like sheep!

@@U04104@@
Gentlemen, I welcome this rival emperor, for I feel now for the first time that I’m the true one. I dressed in armor only as a soldier, but now I wear it with a higher purpose. At every court festival, no matter how brilliant, I always felt a deficiency. It was danger I lacked. Danger. When I tilted, I tilted at the ring, as you advised, though in my heart I longed to be truly jousting. You also counseled against war. Had I not listened, by now I would be a hero many times over. When I saw myself mirrored in that realm of fire, I felt myself stamped with the seal of independence. The fearful element pressed horribly in about me, but it was only illusion— a grand illusion! I've always dreamed vaguely of fame and conquest. I will make up now for what I so shamefully neglected. (HERALDS are dispatched to challenge the RIVAL EMPEROR. Enter 浮士德 in armor, his visor half closed, along with the THREE VIOLENT GIANTS, armed and dressed as earlier.)
translation:
@@U04102@@
陛下，当新皇帝突然出现时，我们发现一片混乱，一开始我们感到很有趣。现在，暴徒们在假旗后面，按照指示，有序地穿过平原——像羊一样！

@@U04104@@
先生们，我欢迎这位竞争对手的皇帝，因为我现在第一次感觉到我是真正的皇帝。我穿着盔甲只是作为一名士兵，但现在我穿着它有着更高的目的。每逢宫廷节日，无论多么辉煌，我总感到不足。我缺少的是危险。危险。当我倾斜时，我就像你建议的那样倾斜在擂台上，尽管我内心渴望真正的比武。您还建议反对战争。如果我不听的话，现在我已经多次成为英雄了。当我看到自己在那个火国的镜像中时，我感觉自己被盖上了独立的印记。可怕的元素可怕地压迫着我，但这只是幻觉——一个巨大的幻觉！我一直模糊地梦想着名誉和征服。我现在要弥补我如此可耻地忽视的事情。 （传令官被派去挑战竞争对手的皇帝。浮士德身穿盔甲，面罩半合着，与三个暴力巨人一起上场，他们全副武装，打扮得像之前一样。）
